sections.overall: Following a well-received Dynasty show, there were plenty of changes in the rankings this week! The highest rated one-on-one match was Jon Moxley vs Will Ospreay (8.55), which led to big gains for both of them. The Young Bucks vs Okada & Takeshita was the highest rated match of all (8.96) consolidated Matt and Nick's place at number 1 in the Men's Tag rankings
sections.mens: Along with Ospreay, MJF gained plenty of places this week: up from #5 to #10. His first time in the top 5 since 2023! Also, we saw good gains from Kenny Omega, Darby Alin and Andrade El Idolo. Kyle Fletcher remains technically #1, however with a confirmed injury, he is due to soon hit the 'inactive' status and drop out of the rankings.
sections.womens: No major changes in the Women's Division in the rankings other than the re-entry of Queen Aminata. Welcome back! Thekla and Jamie Hayter both gained several points for their title match but both still behind Kris Statlander. Kris has not had a match lasting longer than 5 minutes since Revolution, so will become inactive soon unless something changes.
sections.menstag: The Young Bucks excellent match helped to extend their advantage over FTR, who gained slightly from their decent but less spectacular (7.56) title match against Cage & Copeland. Okada & Takeshita have re-entered the Men's Tag rankings at number 3, though based on the post-match aftermath, it is highly unlikely we will see these two team again anytime soon!
sections.womenstag: After being on top of the division for a long time, The Timeless Lovebombs have finally become inactive, handing over #1 by default to Sisters of Sin. The Women's Tag title match was on the pre-show, so did not count. Divine Dominion need a non-squash, non-pre-show match to see a proper shift in their rating.
sections.trios: The Dogs have entered the Trios rankings down at number 6 - their entry rating brought down by a below-average title match at Dynasty (5.54). The Conglomeration (Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong) is the new Trio to look out for. As they have only had one match, they do not make the rankings list, yet!
